description: Main source file for an MQTT client application on Zephyr RTOS, connecting to Azure IoT using MQTT over TLS, with network management and DNS resolution.

methods.name: tls_init
methods.description: Initializes TLS credentials for secure MQTT connection.

methods.name: prepare_fds
methods.description: Prepares socket poll file descriptors based on MQTT transport type.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for socket events with a specified timeout.

methods.name: broker_init
methods.description: Initializes broker address, optionally using DNS resolution and proxy settings.

methods.name: client_init
methods.description: Configures MQTT client parameters including credentials, buffers, and TLS settings.

methods.name: mqtt_event_handler
methods.description: Handles MQTT events such as connection, disconnection, message receipt, and acknowledgments.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to the device event topic.

methods.name: poll_mqtt
methods.description: Continuously polls MQTT input while connected.

methods.name: timeout_for_publish
methods.description: Generates a random timeout between 10-15 seconds for publishing.

methods.name: publish_timeout
methods.description: Callback to publish message periodically based on timeout.

methods.name: try_to_connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to MQTT broker with retries.

methods.name: get_mqtt_broker_addrinfo
methods.description: Resolves MQTT broker hostname via DNS.

methods.name: connect_to_cloud_and_publish
methods.description: Main routine to connect to cloud and start publishing messages.

methods.name: check_network_connection
methods.description: Monitors DHCP address acquisition and network status.

methods.name: abort_mqtt_connection
methods.description: Aborts MQTT connection and cancels publishing.

methods.name: l4_event_handler
methods.description: Handles network layer events such as connection and disconnection.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point initializing TLS, network, and starting MQTT connection process.
